sectors.ai: Buy dips in consumer names with direct IDR revenue and domestic distribution (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) as BI's easing cycle and Ramadan restocking drive near-term upside; trim US-exposed FMCG laggards. Watch for profit-taking after the 18-25% spikes, but structural local-demand strength supports adding on pullbacks ahead of Q1 earnings.
